direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh at 1366x768, overflow hidden; 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; rendered scene at least 70% of main with independent reserved zones for callouts, stations and jobs, no overlap; rail targets equal width, at least 36px, non-wrapping, aria-current, arrow-key movement
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22), silver #C5CCD4, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68), emerald #A8F04A with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, x marker and plain OFFLINE text; official logo immutable in black, emerald and brushed silver at native aspect in header and opening story only
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body, no label under 12px, header tabs spanning most of header at 16px+, 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions driven by real state; 160-220ms ease-out selection, one 240ms route trace on state change; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while pattern, x marker and OFFLINE text retain meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset, pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; compact horizontal rail only; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; reserved side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then Authorize this decision wall; pending task proposal deliberately untracked until human approval, blocked prior tasks and approved recovery plan can coexist while replacements await approval; action bar Back left, status centre, one primary right; skip-to-stage, Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite
